linkedin.text:
The island brief is always the same: everyone together, near the water, without spending the week on a coach.

This is from a programme we produced in the Philippines. Villas and beach within one property boundary, so the whole group moves on foot and the day has no dead transfer hours in it.

That single decision — accommodation and activity on one site — is worth more than almost any upgrade you can buy. It removes the two things that quietly ruin island programmes: the 45-minute transfer that becomes 70 in season, and the group that fragments because half of them stayed by the pool.

What it costs you is choice. One property means one kitchen, one beach, one bar. If your group needs variety across five days, a single-site island plan will start to feel small by day four, and we will say so before you book it.

Planning an island programme for 2026? Tell us how many nights.
